create_fine_tuning_job: create a fine-tuning job on OpenAI or Azure OpenAI with async or sync client support
cancel_fine_tuning_job: cancel an ongoing OpenAI fine-tuning job by job ID using sync or async API
retrieve_fine_tuning_job: retrieve the status and details of an OpenAI fine-tuning job by its ID
list_fine_tuning_jobs: list OpenAI fine-tuning jobs with optional pagination via after cursor and limit
get_openai_client: get an OpenAI or Azure OpenAI client configured with API key, base URL, timeout, and retries
